questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Given that P = {2, 4, 6, 8, 10}, list the members of P that are NOT multiples of 4... how many are they?
questions.explanation: Multiples of 4 in P are 4 and 8, so the other three (2, 6, 10) are not.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: In a survey of 60 people, 35 read the Punch, 30 read the Guardian and 5 read neither. How many read both?
questions.explanation: Readers of at least one = 60 - 5 = 55; both = 35 + 30 - 55 = 10.

questions.q: If A is the set of even numbers from 1 to 15 and B is the set of multiples of 3 from 1 to 15, find n(A intersect B).
questions.explanation: A intersect B holds common members 6 and 12 only, so n = 2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: After a discount of 10%, a shirt costs ₦4,500. What was the marked price in naira?
questions.explanation: 90% of the marked price is 4500, so the marked price = 4500/0.9 = 5000.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Express 45 out of 60 as a percentage.
questions.explanation: 45 out of 60 is 45/60 = 3/4, and three quarters is 75 per cent.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Share ₦7,000 between Kofi and Ada in the ratio 3:4. How much does Ada receive, in naira?
questions.explanation: Total parts = 7, so one part = 1000; Ada gets 4 parts = 4000.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: If x:y = 2:3 and x = 8, find y.
questions.explanation: Each part is 8/2 = 4, so y = 3 x 4 = 12.

questions.explanation: 8 km per litre, so 15 litres gives 120 km.

questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.explanation: Adding 2 to both sides gives 3x = 12, and dividing by 3 gives x = 4.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Solve the pair of simultaneous equations x + y = 7 and x - y = 3 for x.
questions.explanation: Adding the equations gives 2x = 10, so x = 5.

questions.explanation: Subtracting 5 from both sides gives 2x < 6, so x < 3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Find the larger root of the equation x squared - 5x + 6 = 0.
questions.explanation: (x-2)(x-3) = 0 gives x = 2 or x = 3; the larger root is 3.

questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: z varies directly as the square of x. When x = 3, z = 18. Find z when x = 4.
questions.explanation: z = 2x squared, so at x = 4, z = 32.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: y varies jointly as x and z. When x = 2 and z = 3, y = 12. Find y when x = 5 and z = 4.
questions.explanation: y = kxz with k = 12/6 = 2, so y = 2 x 5 x 4 = 40.

questions.q: An angle at the centre of a circle is 70 degrees. Find the angle subtended by the same arc at the circumference.
questions.explanation: The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference: 70/2 = 35.

questions.explanation: An angle subtended by a diameter at the circumference is always a right angle.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Find the perimeter of a rectangle 12 cm long and 8 cm wide, in centimetres.
questions.explanation: Perimeter is twice length plus width: 2(12 + 8) = 40 cm.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Find the area of a triangle with base 10 cm and height 6 cm, in square centimetres.
questions.explanation: Area = half base times height = 0.5 x 10 x 6 = 30.

questions.q: Find the area of a trapezium with parallel sides 6 cm and 10 cm and height 5 cm, in square centimetres.
questions.explanation: Area = half the sum of parallel sides times height = 0.5(6+10) x 5 = 40.

questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Find the mode of the numbers 2, 3, 3, 5, 7, 3, 8.
questions.explanation: 3 appears three times, more than any other number.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: On a pie chart, an angle of 72 degrees represents 12 students. How many students does the whole chart represent?
questions.explanation: 72/360 = 1/5 of the total is 12, so the total is 60.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: A fair die is thrown once. What is the probability of getting an even number?
questions.explanation: Three even faces out of six equally likely faces gives 1/2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: A basket contains 6 red and 8 blue identical beads. One bead is picked at random. Find the probability that it is red.

questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Two fair coins are tossed together. Find the probability of getting at least one head.
questions.explanation: Of the four equally likely outcomes HH, HT, TH, TT, three contain a head.
